# Toronto Health Equity

> > A demographic data collection initiative by Ontario Health Toronto to measure and advance health equity across Community Health Centres and hospitals in the Toronto region.

The Measuring Health Equity (MHE) Project provides standardized tools, training, and implementation guidance for collecting 13-variable demographic data in healthcare settings. This initiative helps Toronto healthcare providers identify and address health disparities through systematic patient demographic data collection.

## Key Topics

- MHE Data Set
- Demographic data collection
- Health equity measurement
- Community Health Centres (CHCs)
- Ontario Health Toronto
- Standardized demographic questions
- Toronto healthcare settings
- Patient demographics
- Hospital implementation tools
- Staff training and education
- Data quality and collection
- Toronto Central LHIN
- Healthcare equity initiatives
- 13-variable demographic framework

## Getting Started

- [Measuring Health Equity – Demographic Data Collection in Health Care](https://torontohealthequity.ca): Homepage for Ontario Health Toronto's demographic data collection initiative
- [The Guide – Measuring Health Equity](https://torontohealthequity.ca/guide): Implementation guide for demographic data collection in healthcare

## Implementation Resources

- [Tools – Measuring Health Equity](https://torontohealthequity.ca/tools): Health equity tools for CHCs and hospitals to collect demographic data
- [Demographic Questions – Measuring Health Equity](https://torontohealthequity.ca/demographic-questions): Standardized 13-variable demographic questions for Toronto healthcare

## Training & Education

- [Training – Measuring Health Equity](https://torontohealthequity.ca/training): Training materials for MHE Data Set and demographic data collection
